title: A boundary point of a finite-type image is reached by a DVR
statement: Let $g:U\to Y$ be a finite-type morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-finite-type-morphism], where $Y$ is locally Noetherian [pqf-def-locnoeth]. For every point $y\in\overline{g(|U|)}\setminus g(|U|)$ there exist a discrete valuation ring $A$ [def-sc-discrete-valuation-ring], its fraction field $K$, and morphisms $u:\operatorname{Spec}K\to U$ and $v:\operatorname{Spec}A\to Y$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum] such that $g\circ u=v\circ j$ and $v(s_A)=y$, where $j:\operatorname{Spec}K\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ is induced by $A\hookrightarrow K$ and $s_A$ is the point corresponding to the maximal ideal of $A$. The bar denotes closure in the Zariski topology of $Y$.

source.place: Tag 0CM2 (limits-lemma-reach-point-closure-Noetherian), restricted to points outside the image. The boundary restriction excludes the trivial-specialization error in the unrestricted statement (see report).

proof.text: Apply [lem-sfb-boundary-affine-local-domain-model] to $g$ and $y$. Its hypotheses are exactly the finite-type, locally Noetherian and missing-image-point hypotheses here. Obtain $W=\operatorname{Spec}C\subseteq U$, $V=\operatorname{Spec}B\subseteq Y$, their finite-type map $\varphi:B\to C$, primes $\mathfrak r,\mathfrak q,\mathfrak p$, and $R\subseteq L=\kappa(\mathfrak r)$ as stated there. In particular $y$ is represented by $\mathfrak p$ in $V$.

source.place: Tag 0CM2, limits-lemma-reach-point-closure-Noetherian, proof, restricted to a point outside the image; affine-coordinate expansion.

proof.text: Apply [lem-sfb-local-domain-affine-dvr-square] with these $B,C,\varphi,\mathfrak r,R$ and the factorization $\alpha:B\to R$ of $B\to L$. Step 1 supplies that $R$ is a nonfield Noetherian local domain, that its fraction subfield is the induced copy of $\kappa(\mathfrak q)$, and that $\alpha^{-1}(\mathfrak m_R)=\mathfrak p$. Thus every hypothesis is met. Obtain a DVR $A\subseteq L$ with fraction field $L$ and a commuting affine square whose closed point maps to $\mathfrak p$.

source.place: Tag 0CM2, limits-lemma-reach-point-closure-Noetherian, proof, restricted to a point outside the image; affine-coordinate expansion.

proof.text: Compose the two horizontal maps of that affine square with the open immersions $W\hookrightarrow U$ and $V\hookrightarrow Y$. Since $g|_W$ is induced by $\varphi$, associativity gives the required square over $g$. The closed point still maps to $y$, represented by $\mathfrak p$ in $V$. Take the field denoted $K$ in the conclusion to be $L$.

source.place: Tag 0CM2, limits-lemma-reach-point-closure-Noetherian, proof, restricted to a point outside the image; affine-coordinate expansion.
